policy: Only these exact regular-file paths may be considered in a later separately authorized publication. Verify frozen hashes, inspect intended recipient/access scope, and obtain required permission before sharing. No glob or recursive directory publication is allowed.
excluded_categories: All paths not exactly listed above, including other INPUTS.json targets and all other candidate files
Passwords, credentials, private connection URL files, authentication tokens, key material and secret environment values
Raw phase/trace JSON, raw database or stage/queue snapshots, dumps, worker IPC payloads and unrestricted logs
Cache and bytecode directories/files, including __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache and *.pyc
Git metadata, installed environments, temporary files, archives and symlinks
json_exception_policy: Only the exact documentary JSON manifest/receipt/allowlist paths above are eligible. A .json extension, hash reference or historical evidence label does not permit raw phase/trace JSON publication.
